mechanism: Clarithromycin inhibits CYP3A4 while eslicarbazepine induces CYP3A4, leading to reduced clarithromycin levels and potential treatment failure; eslicarbazepine levels may also be affected through enzyme induction pathways.
action: Consider alternative antibiotic (e.g., doxycycline, amoxicillin) or monitor eslicarbazepine efficacy closely; if clarithromycin is necessary, assess for reduced anti-infective effect.
